# Signed-note compatibility fixtures

`spec-note-v1.json` is a transparency-dev signed note (Ed25519, x/mod
sumdb/note format) generated by `generate/` with the real Go library, then
committed. It is the **shared oracle** for two independent implementations:

- `service/tessera-runtime/note_fixture_test.go` (Go, `golang.org/x/mod/sumdb/note`)
- the registry's TypeScript tests (`service/api/tests/unit/signed-note-spec.test.ts`)

Both verify the same bytes — a signature that satisfies one must satisfy the
other, so any drift between the TS implementation and the ecosystem format
fails CI.

Deterministic by construction: the Ed25519 key is derived from a fixed seed
(and Ed25519 signatures are deterministic), the tree root is hashed from a
constant, so regenerating produces byte-identical output.

Regenerate (only when intentionally changing the fixture):

```bash
cd service/tessera-runtime/testdata/signed-notes/generate
go run . > ../spec-note-v1.json
```

The keys inside are test-only; they guard nothing.
